mode: Behavioral scenarios; expected outcomes are rubrics, not executed MCP results

evals.prompt: One lead completed qualification but stayed in New Lead.
evals.expected_output: The skill proves authoritative completion and target-stage validity before using the dedicated qualification repair path, then re-reads and diagnoses again.

evals.prompt: A lead is in the wrong stage and the user asks to force it to another pipeline.
evals.expected_output: The skill checks pipeline ownership/transition rules and refuses guessed cross-pipeline movement.

evals.prompt: Twenty leads show the same missing attribute after AI chats.
evals.expected_output: The skill first establishes a common root cause and hands the systemic issue to qualification/AI/schema rather than silently patching twenty records.

evals.prompt: Conversation text says the customer changed city from Delhi to Noida.
evals.expected_output: The skill uses the latest explicit correction if it is valid for the canonical attribute, with trace/lead evidence and read-back.

evals.prompt: A write timed out while repairing the lead.
evals.expected_output: The skill reads current lead state before any retry and avoids duplicate/conflicting mutations.
